newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS LIFTED SLIGHTLY ON GOOD Q1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS LIFTED SLIGHTLY ON GOOD Q1 RESULTS.

text.p: Latvian stocks saw a slight injection of life on good first quarter results poste by, among others, Riga Transport Fleet, dealers said.
Total turnover rose slightly to 76,000 lats from 58,000 lats and Rietumu index slipped 0.07 prc to 176.05 while Saule10 was up 0.20 pct to 150.31.
"Amid the total hopelessness on the bourse we today had some good first quarter results adding more life," Artis Goba, a dealer with Saules Bank, told Reuters.
Riga Transport Fleet rose six santimes to 1.29 lats after posting a good Q1 profit of 1.17 mln lats on trade of 27,000 lats. It was the bourse's most traded stock today.

"RTF showed a Q1 profit that was bigger than Unibanka's, but its shares are three times cheaper," Goba said. "Latvian Bridges and Misa Peat have also posted good figures and we can expect some revival in May," he added.
Unibanka lost ground further to 3.45 lats from 3.47 lats on a small volume of 8,300 lats.
Secondary list was mostly idle involumes except for Daugavpils Chain and Valmiera Glassfibre on volumes of 19,200 lats and 10,400 lats respectively.
Chain slipped to 2.35 from 2.40 lats and Valmiera lost one santime to 1.53 lats.
